notes: Scooter's Coffee 2026 FDD Item 19. Data covers Sections A-E: (A) Average Gross Sales for Participating Kiosk and End Cap Stores 2021-2025; (B) Average Customer Ticket for same cohorts 2021-2025; (C) Statement of Sales, Expenses and Earnings for Reporting Kiosk and End Cap Stores (2025, quartile breakdowns); (D) Same-Store Net Sales Growth 2020-2025; (E) Average Gross Sales during first full calendar month for new stores 2021-2025. Section E values are monthly (first full calendar month), not annual — flagged as ramp-snapshot. Section D reports percentage growth rates, not dollar values. All Section C values are annual averages per store. Note: Overhead in Section C is estimated at $52,500 (not the $49,800 mentioned in the notes — the $52,500 figure is what appears in the tables, which includes Technology Fee separately per the notes). Actually re-reading: notes say overhead avg is $49,800 and Technology Fee is separate at $4,200/yr = $350/mo, so $49,800 + $4,200 = $54,000 but tables show Overhead=52,500 and Technology Fee=4,200. The $52,500 is used in the tables. The notes say $49,800 is the overhead average — there may be a slight discrepancy or rounding. Extracting table values as authoritative.
